description: A Canadian Forest Service research team publishes a database of wildfire evacuation orders across forested Canadian regions from 1980 through 2019. Zenodo supplies the CSV and a metadata document under CC BY 4.0. Each documented evacuation includes location, estimated population, broad evacuee-count category, order and end dates, reason and linked fire characteristics such as size and ignition. The publishers compiled events from more than two thousand news reports and supplemented them with emergency-management agencies. These records can calibrate evacuation demand and warning or transport-response scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this event database. Coverage is reported forest-region evacuations, not every threatened community or spontaneous departure. A limitation is that news visibility and agency records vary over time; estimated evacuee categories are coarse and may differ from actual movements. Indigenous reserve status is recorded but does not establish each community’s local response capacity. No CSV was downloaded or event count independently audited.
